scores.rationale: The stated priorities concern credit, academic fit, semester feasibility, cost and logistics, not self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No source or evidence class is selected to evaluate freedom for self-guided exploration or flexible local experiences.
Facts about direct admission, housing and student organizations do not establish how a named option supports self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No named option has a concrete fact establishing heavily packaged or group-managed activities. Generic cautions about commercial services do not satisfy this check.
The report does not compare self-guided experiences with packaged or group-managed activities on a common decision axis.
Recommendations are based on academic access, credit, eligibility and cost, not the preference for self-guided exploration and flexible local experience.
No otherwise viable named option is downgraded because its activities are heavily packaged or group-managed.
The preparation plan contains academic and logistical actions but no executable step implementing self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No threshold, time allocation, sequence rule or checkpoint governs self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
The report gives no condition under which heavily packaged or group-managed activities would become preferable.
No visible chain connects the specified experiential preference to evidence and then to a recommendation or action.
